name: code-search

# Fast, path-scoped feedback for the nexus-code-search extension (v3.15.0
# context-map Phase 1). Triggers ONLY when the extension tree or this workflow
# changes, so unrelated commits spend no minutes here. The comprehensive,
# always-on gate remains the `tests` job in ci.yml; this job is the quick scoped
# signal for extension-only work.
on:
  # v4.0.0 event separation: the `push` leg to the same protected branches was
  # removed. Under a pull-request-only merge policy that push IS the merge commit
  # of the pull request that just ran, so the tree is identical and the second run
  # cannot discover anything the first did not. See
  # docs/policy/ci-cd-lifecycle-contract.md section 4.
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - 'extensions/nexus-code-search/**'
      - '.github/workflows/code-search.yml'
      - 'scripts/ci/**'
      - 'scripts/ci/requirements.in'
      - 'scripts/ci/requirements-py311.txt'

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref so only the latest commit's run
# survives (the single largest action-minute saver).
# v3.15.8 Phase 9.3: least privilege. This workflow builds and tests only --
# no gh CLI, comments or pushes; retained reports need no extra permission -- so read-only
# contents is the complete requirement.
permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test-network-blocked:
    name: Test with outbound network blocked
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7

      - name: Repository-native code-search-offline profile
        run: python scripts/ci/run.py --profile full --only code-search-offline --reports-dir reports

      - name: Publish native profile summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: cat reports/summary.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" || true

      - name: Retain native profile reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: code-search-offline-reports
          path: reports/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7
